geometry_type: Point / Polygon (EPSG:7855 or EPSG:7856 GDA2020 MGA)
description: Master spatial record for each historical or pastoral standing structure or ruin. Captures structure ID, structure name, GNSS points/polygons, camera make/number, photo frames, volunteer WHS pre-entry hazards, footprint dimensions, foundations/subfloor, wall framing, masonry, cladding, roof forms, verandahs, chimneys, exterior openings, construction phasing overview, and archaeological integrity synthesis.

Detailed interior room-by-room record (one form per room) linked to sequential room letters (STR-01-A, STR-01-B). Records inferred room function, internal dimensions and floor area, floor materials and board widths with subfloor probing notes, wall substrates and linings (wallpaper/newspaper stratigraphy), ceiling framing and cornices, internal joinery, hearth/stove and fixed services, alterations/scars, and Miles Lewis stratigraphic phasing summary.

page_reference: Form 3 (Single / Repeatable Sheet per room: Sections 1-3)
description: Catalogue of portable artefacts, pastoral equipment, wool handling gear, stationary machinery, workshop tools, domestic furnishings, stoves, containers, and salvaged fabric items located within a specific room space. Linked via hierarchical ID (e.g. STR-01-A-01) with item category, detailed physical description, material composition, maker brand/stamps, dimensions, condition, photo frame number, and conservation/in-situ notes.

foreign_keys: structure_id -> structures.structure_id, room_id -> rooms_spaces.room_id (optional), object_id -> room_objects_inventory.object_id (optional)
description: Master photographic register cross-referencing all digital camera exposures to physical architectural components, floor plan orientation arrows, and room spaces. Enforces one-camera-per-form protocol and logs photographer names, camera make/model/ID, date, photo frame number, hierarchical component code (e.g. STR-01-A), camera facing orientation, scale size used, north arrow presence, and detailed descriptive captions.

Relative chronological phasing framework based on Miles Lewis Building Developments methodology. Groups rooms, wings, and structural components into construction stages (Original Core, Early Additions, Verandah Enclosures, Re-roofing, Modern Repairs) justified by physical structural junctions, masonry seams, fastener types, and timber conversion marks.

Catalogue of diagnostic chronological index marks: corrugated iron sheet brands (Lysaght Orb, Gospel Oak, Redcliffe Crown), brick frogs, stove maker badges (Metters, Dover), cast-iron foundry marks, carpenter assembly Roman numerals, timber sawmill brands, and historic pencil inscriptions or shearing tallies.
